# Shipped orders pay 10%. Local pickup pays $0.

> Free Facebook Marketplace seller fee calculator: 10% of the buyer-paid total (item price + shipping + tax collected) on a shipped checkout order, $0.80 minimum fee, $0 for local pickup, plus the flat $20 dispute penalty if one applies. Real profit, price for a target profit. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
